integrity: Proof uses a uniform elementary-collapse construction; a finite independently reconstructive checker covers 190 parameter pairs. Comparisons with unindexed or uninspected literature carry residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Only d>=3 and n>=2d+5 for synchronous firing on an oriented cycle with four initially unit-occupied sites; geometric torus proof not a classification of arbitrary avalanche complexes.
title: An infinite torus family of four-grain avalanche complexes
